title: Checkpoint: the missing recipe card
instructions: Read the complete story before filling any gap. Choose one word from the shared bank for each gap. Each word can be used once; three words will remain unused.

parts.prompt: Missing recipe gap 1: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: ‘Relieved’ describes a person’s feeling, not a workbench covered with objects.
choice_rationales.B: A past-tense action cannot describe how the workbench looked.
choice_rationales.C: ‘Searched’ is a verb and does not fit after ‘looked unusually’.
choice_rationales.D: ‘Cluttered’ describes a surface covered untidily with many objects.
choice_rationales.E: An adverb cannot describe the workbench in this construction.
choice_rationales.F: ‘Proud’ describes a person’s emotion, not the physical state of a workbench.
choice_rationales.G: ‘Assumed’ is a verb and does not describe the crowded surface.
choice_rationales.H: ‘Quietly’ cannot describe how the workbench looked.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Cluttered’ matches the bowls, menus and lists covering the workbench.

parts.prompt: Missing recipe gap 2: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: An adjective cannot introduce the fact that the card was missing.
choice_rationales.B: ‘Discovered’ shows that Anya found out the card was missing as preparation began.
choice_rationales.C: ‘Searched that’ is not a valid reporting construction.
choice_rationales.D: ‘Cluttered’ is an adjective and cannot be the main action.
choice_rationales.E: The sentence requires a main verb, not an adverb.
choice_rationales.F: ‘Proud’ cannot introduce a clause beginning with ‘that’.
choice_rationales.G: ‘Assumed’ would mean Anya accepted the loss without evidence, but the story presents the missing card as a fact noticed during preparation.
choice_rationales.H: An adverb cannot supply the missing main verb.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Discovered’ fits the moment Anya became aware of the missing card.

parts.prompt: Missing recipe gap 3: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: The sentence needs a past-tense action performed by Anya and Farid.
choice_rationales.B: They cannot discover through a tray; they examine it to find the card.
choice_rationales.C: ‘Searched through’ is the correct collocation for examining the tray carefully.
choice_rationales.D: An adjective cannot express the pair’s action.
choice_rationales.E: An adverb cannot be the main verb after the compound subject.
choice_rationales.G: ‘Assumed through’ is not a valid construction.
choice_rationales.H: The sentence needs a main action in addition to any manner adverb.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Searched’ completes the collocation ‘searched through’ and follows the effort to recover the card.

parts.prompt: Missing recipe gap 4: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: An adjective cannot modify the action ‘placed’ in this structure.
choice_rationales.B: ‘Discovered placed’ is not a grammatical verb sequence.
choice_rationales.D: ‘Cluttered’ does not describe the manner of placing the card.
choice_rationales.E: ‘Accidentally’ matches ‘without noticing’ and explains why the card was hidden.
choice_rationales.F: ‘Proud’ is an adjective and does not modify ‘placed’.
choice_rationales.G: ‘Assumed placed’ is not a valid construction.
choice_rationales.H: ‘Quietly’ is grammatically possible but does not express the unintended action signalled by ‘without noticing’.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Accidentally’ is the only option that explains an unintended placement the volunteer did not notice.

parts.prompt: Missing recipe gap 5: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: ‘Relieved’ describes the release of worry when the feared loss proves untrue.
choice_rationales.B: ‘Discovered’ is a verb and cannot follow ‘felt’ with this meaning.
choice_rationales.C: ‘Searched’ does not name the emotion caused by recovering the card.
choice_rationales.D: ‘Cluttered’ describes a place or arrangement, not the team’s emotion.
choice_rationales.E: An adverb cannot complete ‘felt’ as an emotional state here.
choice_rationales.F: The story emphasises escape from a feared loss, not achievement that would make the team proud.
choice_rationales.G: ‘Assumed’ is a verb and does not name the resulting emotion.
choice_rationales.H: ‘Quietly’ cannot name what the team felt.

parts.correct_explanation: ‘Relieved’ follows the emotional change from fearing the card was gone to recovering it.
